payload.title: TI P4-11: move threat-intelligence.anth.us (and staging host) to the new app, with rollback
payload.description:
## Goal
Retire the old Threat Intelligence deployment and the fork-only code, and leave docs and procedures current. Mirrors Pilobol.us P3-09 (PPY-11c365), second half.

## Context (FACT)
- Old resources: Amplify app d3on1y5vlrxmam (branch main, repo anthusai/threat-intelligence, auto build disabled by P4-04); backend stack amplify-d3on1y5vlrxmam-main-branch-aeb7dfa526 with nested stacks (auth, storage, data with 39 DynamoDB tables and about a dozen Lambdas, knowledgevectors S3 Vectors bucket) and 3 SSM secrets under /amplify/d3on1y5vlrxmam/main-branch-aeb7dfa526/ (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET); media bucket amplify-d3on1y5vlrxmam-ma-papyrusmediabucket0dab24-vq9lqoedok0k (254 MB, auto-delete on stack deletion); old Cognito pool us-east-1_lAtce7ZTu (2 users) with domain b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318; no backups configured; no EventBridge rules named for the app; no SES rule for TI (the active SES rule set is the p.apyr.us one).
- Papyrus develop still carries a copy of publications/threat_intelligence/ (22 files) and registers the TI brand in its repo-root papyrus.config.ts (standard-site.md 1.2: moves out; delete once TI is on the packages). Pilobol.us P3-09 removes the Pilobol.us brand; coordinate so both edits do not collide.
- The fork repo has branches cursor/* (5), epic/* (2), feature/ti-newsroom-theme, develop and 1 open PR; it is a GitHub fork of AnthusAI/Papyrus (isFork true).

## Exact steps
1. Sign-off period (Ryan decides length; recommendation 7 days of use after P4-11) with the old backend kept.
2. Research data decision (Q4) executed: either copy the research tables and corpora/newsroom S3 prefixes (separate follow-up) or take a final archive (aws s3 sync of the media bucket and a DynamoDB export to a retained archive bucket) before deletion.
3. Ryan or on his explicit yes: delete the old Amplify app, the backend stack and nested stacks (confirm bucket auto-delete is intended), the 3 SSM secrets, the old Cognito pool domain and pool; remove stale URIs from the Google client; delete leftover amplifyconsole-backend-role if created.
4. TI repo: delete merged feature branches and cursor/* branches, close or move the open PR, update AGENTS.md and README, decide fork detachment (Q2).
5. Papyrus PR (develop): delete publications/threat_intelligence/ and the TI brand registration in the repo-root papyrus.config.ts, update docs/standard-site.md 3.2 to "done", add docs/migrations/threat-intelligence.md with the final record (commands run, ids, dates), update docs/site-hosting.md ("Threat Intelligence uses one repo plus one WEB_COMPUTE app" and the split-reader table), remove the TI rows in docs mentioning the old app id, correct the table in the epic.
6. Add the TI runbook entry (app ids, stack, domain, secrets names, GitHub App connection date) to the TI repo docs.

## Acceptance checks
- aws amplify get-app --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam returns NotFound; aws cloudformation describe-stacks for the old stack returns not found; the old pool and bucket are gone (names only checked).
- threat-intelligence.anth.us still green on the full probe list from P4-11 after deletions.
- Papyrus develop builds and tests green without publications/threat_intelligence; the TI brand loads only from the TI repo.
- git grep for d3on1y5vlrxmam in Papyrus and TI repos finds only the migration record.

## Rollback
None after deletion (hence the archive step and the sign-off period).

## Risks
Deleting the data stack deletes the research corpus if Q4 is unresolved.

## Needs Ryan
Yes: sign-off, the Q4 and Q2 decisions, the deletions (or his explicit yes), PR merges.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
